visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair wearing a grey short-sleeved utility shirt is sitting outdoors at night. He is positioned in front of a dark camper van with a screen door. On a black table labeled 'CAMPFIRE' in front of him are several portable fans. He holds a yellow fan in his right hand and a black fan in his left. (2) The camera zooms in on the black Snowpeak fan as the man demonstrates its rotating feature. The lighting is bright studio-style despite the outdoor night setting, illuminating the texture of the fan's plastic casing and the man's facial features. (3) The man holds a yellow Ryobi water mist fan. He demonstrates its multi-functional battery pack by detaching it. The background remains the static outdoor campsite with the van. (4) A close-up shot focuses on a black and red neck-mounted cooling device held by the man. He gestures toward the internal metal cooling plates with his thumb. (5) The man puts the neck cooling device around his neck, adjusting it with both hands. The camera captures his concentrated expression as he fits the device. (6) The man demonstrates a small green waist fan. He clips it to his belt and shows how the bottom of his shirt clips over the fan to direct air upwards. (7) A brief cutaway shows the man standing next to a woman in an indoor or sheltered area. He points to the waist fan's effect on his shirt while the woman watches. (8) Returning to the outdoor table, the man holds the waist fan and the neck cooler, summarizing his points while gesturing frequently with his hands.
